hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: G0002 is exactly F_m(z). G0001 is obtained from F_m(z) by expanding the quotient as a finite geometric series in z^{-2}, which under the stated assumptions gives Sum_{k=0}^m z**(m - 2*k). G0003 is obtained by specializing z = exp(I*theta) in F_m(z) and applying Euler's formula to convert the resulting quotient to sin((m+1)*theta)/sin(theta).
hypotheses.rationale: All three catalog expressions are structurally the same Laurent-polynomial quotient up to the stated assumptions. G0002 is the quotient form; G0001 is its finite geometric expansion under z != 0 and z**2 != 1; G0003 is the unit-circle specialization z = exp(I*theta) using Euler's formula.
